ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 1:6 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark-gray/black) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast punctate white circular focal spots (ranging 5-25 pixels in diameter) on a continuous dark-gray/black field. No macro-level contiguous geometric banding or large-scale mottling detected.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 85-90 degrees and a vertical depth estimated at 12% of visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the continuous trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 5-20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe trailing edges exhibit a slight concave sweep near the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High spatial density of circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the entire visible surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned gray/white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the lower-medial section of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of high-intensity, textured white/yellowish calcified structures (epibionts) attached to the superior-most visible edges of the left lobe and the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant irregular pixel-relief along the superior boundary of the left lobe caused by dense colonization of high-contrast calcified organisms.
